name: p2-first-serve-envelope
criterion: Compare actual AUD3VOL at each serve attenuation step with the nearest 0-64 level to the recorded source plateau amplitude. Source plateaus must be stable under 2/3/4 ms edge trimming; no waveform tolerance is inferred.
contract: Entire first serve envelope, including its held step and second decay phrase, along uninterrupted native gameplay. Pitch remains a separate known failure.
